A '''campaign''' near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gell Mattar]] took place in [[3666 BBY]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Six months after the [[Battle of Alderaan]], Republic forces under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jace Malcom]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]] routed the Imperials, though Shan chose to break off her romantic relationship with Malcom in fear of the man's inner darkness.<ref name="Annihilation" />
